dogecoin.text: Hey @vladtenev, the first crypto I ever bought was dogecoin. I only bought it because I own a shiba inu. I also was naive and gambling. I took all my profits and put it into #Bitcoin. I will never encourage anyone to buy doge. Don’t be a fool kids.
@JXAC_3 He is going to push the dogecoin thing but it serves a bigger purpose. It’s obvious he will be in/out of #Bitcoin as he needs for his businesses. He will never be @saylor though.
